sources.title: Mistral AI - Wikipedia
sources.snippet: Mistral AI SAS (French: [mistʁal]) is a French artificial intelligence (AI) company headquartered in Paris. Founded in 2023, it develops large language models (LLMs), many of which are open-source AI, under licenses such as Apache.
